pyqgis_plugin.name: Cross Section Editor
pyqgis_plugin.description: A plugin for editing cross section data. Primarily for ESTRY-TUFLOW cross-sections.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin for QGIS provides an interactive tool for editing and managing cross-section data. Primarily for use with ESTRY-TUFLOW cross sections.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Search and Replace
pyqgis_plugin.description: Find and replace text across vector layer attributes, with regex, multi-field, and batch pair support.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
A dockable panel for finding and replacing text values in vector layer attributes.
Features: - Target multiple fields at once - Run multiple search/replace pairs in a single pass - Optional regular expression (regex) support with capture group substitution - Case-insensitive matching - Preview changes before applying them - Edits are staged — review in the attribute table and save when ready

pyqgis_plugin.name: LiDAR Fetcher UK
pyqgis_plugin.description: Download LiDAR tiles for England, Scotland and Wales for a polygon or extent, with optional VRT, pyramids, merge and format conversion.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Pick an area (polygon layer or extent), choose one or more LiDAR datasets and download the tiles into a folder. Sources: - England: Environment Agency survey catalogue (composites, time-stamped tiles, National LiDAR Programme, point clouds) - Scotland: Scottish Remote Sensing Portal (Phases 1-6, National LiDAR Programme, Outer Hebrides, Orkney, HES projects) - Wales: DataMapWales (Welsh Government LiDAR 2020-2023 and the NRW archive 1998-2015, converted from millimetres to metres)
Options: - Build a VRT mosaic - Build pyramids (all levels) - Merge the tiles into a single raster - Convert to GeoTIFF, ASCII Grid (.asc) or ESRI Float (.flt)
Also adds Processing Toolbox algorithms (LiDAR Fetcher UK): Download LiDAR tiles, for batch runs and models, and Convert raster to FLT / ASC / GeoTIFF for any raster.
